en: A black and white image of a small train station with a wooden building, visible train tracks in the foreground, and a horse-drawn carriage near the entrance. There are two people standing near the barrier. The station has a steep roof and there are several wooden houses and a fence in the background. The image has a vintage quality, likely early 20th century. In the lower left, the text 'Tonset St.' is visible, and in the lower right, 'ENER. CARL NORMANN.'
